candidates.name: Brugada Syndrome
support_spans: episode of neck and back pain and loss of consciousness
family history revealed that her uncle and two sisters had sudden cardiac death at a young age
ECG Findings:- First episode showed complete atrioventricular block with inferior ST-segment elevation (heart rate 45 bpm)- Second episode showed junctional escape rhythm (heart rate 32 bpm)
contradict_spans: Genetic Testing:- Whole exome sequencing performed on patient and family members showed no abnormalities
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and ECG findings are consistent with Brugada Syndrome, a genetic disorder that can cause sudden cardiac death.
